title: The Demolition Apprenticeship
logline: An eccentric explosive-mining tutor tries to save his bumbling apprentice after a botched blasting drill vaporizes the station magistrate's decorative garden.

roles.description: A half-deaf veteran asteroid blaster who runs an uncertified explosive engineering academy from a rust-streaked tug.
An over-eager demolition apprentice whose mathematical errors consistently produce ten times the calculated blast yield.
A pompous civic magistrate whose prized hydroponic orchid solarium was just turned into fine orbital dust.
A battered industrial mooring clamp where the tutor's explosive training scow is lashed to an asteroid stub.

public_situation: Habitat security in {system} is scouring the docks after an illegal mining blasting cap obliterated the magistrate's ceremonial greenhouse.
private_truth: The apprentice mistook a salvaged naval breaching torpedo warhead for a civilian bedrock charge while trying to impress the tutor.

beats.public_change: Station bailiffs issue an emergency impound warrant for any tug carrying explosive ordnance.

missions.reason: The tutor needs raw ferrite ore rushed to the forge to weld patch plates over the training barge's scorched launcher before bailiffs dock.
missions.private_fact: The tutor still has three live naval torpedoes hidden behind the water tanks that he forgot to report twenty years ago.

beats.public_change: The furious magistrate orders habitat security to freeze the tutor's fuel rations and board the berth.

missions.reason: The terrified apprentice asks the pilot to collect an acoustic dampening report from a habitat botanist to prove the blast had positive soil benefits.
missions.private_fact: The apprentice paid the botanist with stolen station scrip lifted from the magistrate's ruined greenhouse desk.

beats.public_change: The magistrate convenes an emergency dockside hearing to revoke the tutor's blasting licence and jail the apprentice.

missions.reason: The tutor asks the pilot to scan the crater's blast resonance to certify that habitat plumbing vibration triggered the explosion, not the cap.
missions.private_fact: The magistrate had illegally routed station gray water through the greenhouse, creating the gas pocket that amplified the detonation.

player_choice.prompt: The magistrate stands at the berth with bailiffs ready to cuff the apprentice. The sensor readings prove municipal sewage leaks magnified the blast.

options.label: Present evidence of the illegal sewer pipe to humiliate the magistrate into dropping charges
Present the blast as an innovative acoustic aerating experiment and demand a municipal grant
Let the magistrate jail the apprentice to preserve the tutor's personal pension

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot exposes the magistrate's illegal greenhouse plumbing.
resolutions.summary: {role:station_magistrate} drops all charges to conceal illegal sewer diversions, while {role:demolition_tutor} laughs over celebratory engine brew.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot proved a pompous magistrate blew up his own orchids with leaky sewer gas.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot bluffs the council into funding acoustic kinetic aeration.
resolutions.summary: The council awards {role:botching_apprentice} an agricultural acoustic grant, leaving {role:station_magistrate} sputtering with rage.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot abandons the apprentice to preserve the tutor.
resolutions.summary: {role:botching_apprentice} is sentenced to waste recycling, while {role:demolition_tutor} quietly drinks alone in the empty workshop.

resolutions.reached_by: The deliveries fail or the pilot drops the contract.
resolutions.summary: Bailiffs impound the demolition barge and auction the scrap; {role:demolition_tutor} and the apprentice are evicted from {system}.

loose_threads.detail: Fragmented casing shards retrieved from the orchid planter carry tactical military inventory stamps from an unlisted fleet depot.
Habitat engineering ledgers show a massive sewage maintenance rebate credited to an account registered under the magistrate's spouse.

radio_hooks: Orchid solarium detonation in {system} blamed on illegal kinetic mining charges.
Station magistrate demands total ban on private demolition apprenticeship workshops.
Habitat engineers investigate mysterious dockside resonance and plumbing odor.

voice_direction.demolition_tutor: Loud, booming, speaking in clipped rapid phrases with complete nonchalance toward catastrophic structural damage. Never displays panic or regret.
voice_direction.botching_apprentice: High-pitched, nervous, rambling through absurd defensive justifications and clutching a smoldering blast calculator.
voice_direction.station_magistrate: Trembling with aristocratic indignation, spitting out florid legal threats and obsessing over rare orchid cultivars.
